coordinateInterpretation: Welch Mill business/access-area anchor; not a surveyed water-entry point.
accessCondition: No formal/developed public water access at Welch. Use the mill landing only with a current Welch Mill reservation or explicit permission; confirm hours, landing, carry, parking, and fees. Not a public emergency bailout.

evidence.claim: DNR says Welch has no developed public access, parking is limited, and outfitters can provide service.
DNR says no formal public water access exists at Welch and some paddlers use local outfitter services.
Welch Mill trips start at the mill, shuttle customers upstream, and return to the mill; reservations are recommended.
The stored coordinate is within about 16 feet of the public mapped Welch Mill business point and is near, not on, mapped water.
